name: Crystallized Agony AP OLD
description: A violet crystal containing the body of a dead creature, grown from its dying agony, pulses as it exudes motes of flickering energy.
disable: DC 33 Thievery (master) or DC 35 Survival (master) to know where to Strike a specific crystal perfectly on a facet to cause it to shatter harmlessly
reset: A crystallized agony resets automatically and can be triggered again the next round.

generalAbilities.name: Emit Agony
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The crystallized agony is struck hard enough to take damage

Effect A shimmering mote of violet light flashes from the point of origin from the triggering action, unerringly striking the triggering creature. This bolt of agony deals 10d10 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 30 Fortitude Saving Throw).
